dialogs.about: 손녀에게 보낼 편지를 할아버지와 함께 쓰기

lines.en: I am writing a letter to our granddaughter.
That's good. Did the mail come today?
Yes, a postcard came this morning.
Who sent the postcard?
Our son. He sends his love from far away.
Please write my regards in your letter.
lines.ko: 편지에 내 안부도 좀 써 줘요.

lines.en: I will. How do I start? Dear granddaughter?
lines.ko: 그럴게요. 어떻게 시작할까요? 사랑하는 손녀에게라고 쓸까요?

lines.en: Yes, and end with sincerely yours.
Do we have a stamp and an envelope?
I will buy them tomorrow. Thank you for writing.
lines.ko: 내일 사 올게요. 편지 써 줘서 고마워요.

lines.en: Hello. I want to send this envelope.
Hello. Is the address on the back?
Yes, the address is right here.
Good. You need one more stamp.
Can I buy stamps here?
Of course. Here are two stamps.
lines.ko: 그럼요. 우표 두 장 여기 있어요.

lines.en: Thank you. I also have a postcard.
Did you write a greeting on it?
Yes, I wrote it last night.
Your family will reply soon. Have a good day.
lines.ko: 가족이 곧 답장할 거예요. 좋은 하루 보내세요.
